March 9. 1949 Mr. President : I am directed to inform your Honorable Body that the House has  this day passed, under suspension of the rules, H. B. No. 286, by Mr.  Larson, entitled. “AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 103-41-3 AND 103-41-5 OF THE   UTAH CODE ANNOTATED 1943, EXTENDING THE DEFINITION   OF PUBLIC NUISANCE TO INCLUDE THE ALLOWING AND   CAUSING OF SULPHURIC DIOXIDE OR ARSENIC FUMES   OR ACIDS TO BE PRESENT OVER OR ON THE PROPERTY OR   HABITATION OF ANOTHER: PENALTIES," and the same is trans­ mitted herewith for your action. Communication filed. Respectfully, DAVID R. TREVITHICK. Chief Clerk. H. B. No. 286 was read the first time and referred to the Siftinp  Committee.
